name: Jack & Jill
description: AI recruiting marketplace: hiring agents search Jack's opted-in candidate network, score and commit matches, and request consent-gated intros over MCP or REST.

skills.name: Search Candidate Network
skills.description: Search Jack's network of opted-in professionals into pools by query or criteria, then filter and rank them.

skills.name: Commit Candidate Matches
skills.description: Commit the best pool for a hiring assignment into durable matches and record feedback on them.

skills.name: Request Candidate Intros
skills.description: Send moderated messages and consent-gated introduction requests to matched candidates.

skills.name: Manage Hiring Assignments
skills.description: Open and resume hiring assignments with shared working context, hiring handbooks and a notification inbox.
